shared_meaning: a person qualified to practice medicine
distinction_note: Doctor is common in ordinary spoken conversation, while physician is preferred in professional, administrative, and clinical contexts.

shared_meaning: a party that acquires goods or services for money
distinction_note: Buyer is standard everyday terminology, while purchaser is customary in contractual, legal, and corporate procurement documents.

shared_meaning: a structure serving as a permanent domestic dwelling
distinction_note: House is the everyday conversational word, whereas residence is utilized in official, municipal, and legal registries.

shared_meaning: the front part of the human trunk below the chest containing the digestive organs
distinction_note: Belly is familiar and colloquial, whereas abdomen is the precise anatomical and clinical standard.

shared_meaning: the principal activity or profession through which an individual earns a living
distinction_note: Job is ubiquitous in everyday conversation, whereas occupation is standard in government forms, surveys, and formal profiles.

shared_meaning: a licensed practitioner authorized to provide legal advice and represent clients
distinction_note: Lawyer is the standard common term, while attorney appears in formal institutional, courtroom, and statutory titles.

shared_meaning: a destructive uncontrolled burning of property or land
distinction_note: Fire is universal in daily usage, whereas conflagration is restricted to formal prose, literary texts, and official damage reports.

shared_meaning: financial compensation given for labor performed or services rendered
distinction_note: Pay is ordinary spoken English, while remuneration is typical in corporate governance, executive contracts, and legal statutes.

shared_meaning: a written communication sent by one party to another
distinction_note: Letter is the routine everyday term, while missive belongs to diplomatic, official, or elevated literary registers.

shared_meaning: a four-wheeled passenger motor vehicle designed for road transit
distinction_note: Car is the dominant everyday word, whereas automobile is technical, regulatory, or historically formal.

shared_meaning: a coordinated set of clothing items worn together
distinction_note: Outfit is everyday informal vocabulary, while ensemble is preferred in high-fashion, arts, and curated formal settings.

shared_meaning: an informal spoken exchange between two or more participants
distinction_note: Chat denotes casual, lighthearted interaction, whereas conversation is neutral and standard in formal or polite contexts.

shared_meaning: a large and prominent permanent architectural structure
distinction_note: Building is the standard basic noun, while edifice is formal, literary, and architectural.

shared_meaning: the point in time or space at which a process initiates
distinction_note: Start is the standard conversational choice, whereas commencement is reserved for formal ceremonies, legal texts, and administrative procedures.

shared_meaning: a person exercising direct managerial oversight over subordinates
distinction_note: Boss is conversational workplace jargon, while supervisor is the official institutional and corporate title.

shared_meaning: a liquid prepared or suitable for human consumption
distinction_note: Drink is the universal common noun, whereas beverage is used in commercial, food-service, and regulatory labeling.

shared_meaning: a box or chest in which a deceased human body is placed for burial or cremation
distinction_note: Coffin is traditional conversational vocabulary, whereas casket is formal industry terminology used by morticians and funeral homes.

shared_meaning: a secure public facility where criminal offenders are confined
distinction_note: Jail is common spoken English, whereas penitentiary is an official statutory and corrections department designation.

shared_meaning: an act of giving one item and receiving another in return
distinction_note: Swap is informal and colloquial, while exchange is used in formal, economic, and institutional settings.

shared_meaning: an individual hired to perform labor under a contract with an organization
distinction_note: Worker is general and colloquial, whereas employee is the precise formal term in human resources, tax documents, and employment law.
